title: Acyclic cone and cokernel diagram from a lifted cone
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, I an ideal, and P a class of R-modules consisting of projectives and closed under sums and summands, meaning that for every isomorphism P12 ≅ P1 × P2, (P1 belongs to P and P12 belongs to P) if and only if (P1 belongs to P and P2 belongs to P). Let K0 be a bounded-above complex with terms in P and let E be a bounded-above R/I-complex with terms isomorphic to reductions of members of P. Assume the reductions of K0 and E are isomorphic in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There exists a bounded-above acyclic R/I-complex C with terms reducing members of P, such that every bounded-above acyclic class complex A with reduction isomorphic to C yields a right-exact sequence K0 -> A' -> B of R-complexes, with A' acyclic and with terms in P, B bounded above, reduction of B isomorphic to E[1], and the reduced sequence split exact in every degree. The Lean sequence records its first object as equal to K0 and does not require injectivity before reduction.

proof.text: Reduced E terms are projective by the extension/restriction adjunction. E is K-projective; use the proved upstream CochainComplex.IsKProjective.exists_Q_map_eq (which applies Qh_map_bijective and chooses a chain representative) to represent the inverse supplied derived isomorphism, and reflect its derived isomorphism to a quasi-isomorphism.
Use the actual mapping cone and its proved bound, acyclicity and reduced class terms.
For a supplied reduced-cone lift A, strictly lift the cone inclusion using its null-homotopy into the acyclic cone.

Use the actual ShortComplex.cokernelSequence of this strict map. Its exactness and epimorphism are Mathlib facts. Its third object is bounded above since each evaluated cokernel projection is epi out of the bounded-above A. The reduced-cokernel comparison supplies its isomorphism to E[1] and degreewise splitting. The middle object is exactly the supplied A, so its acyclicity and class terms are the hypotheses.

theorem exists_complex_lift_acyclic_enlargement
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (Pclass : Set (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I))]
    (E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)) ℤ)
    (hproj : ∀ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass → Projective P)
    (hclosed : ∀ P₁ P₂ P₁₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R,
      Nonempty (P₁₂ ≅ ModuleCat.of R (P₁ × P₂)) →
      (P₁ ∈ Pclass ∧ P₁₂ ∈ Pclass ↔ P₁ ∈ Pclass ∧ P₂ ∈ Pclass))
    (K₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ)
    (hKbound : ∃ b : ℤ, K₀.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hKterms : ∀ i : ℤ, K₀.X i ∈ Pclass)
    (hEbound : ∃ b : ℤ, E.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hEterms : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass ∧
      Nonempty (E.X i ≅ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj P))
    (hderived : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₀) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj E)) :
    ∃ C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)) ℤ,
      (∃ b : ℤ, C.IsStrictlyLE b) ∧ C.Acyclic ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, ∃ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass ∧
        Nonempty ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj P ≅ C.X i)) ∧
      ∀ A : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ,
        (∃ b : ℤ, A.IsStrictlyLE b) → A.Acyclic →
        (∀ i : ℤ, A.X i ∈ Pclass) →
        Nonempty (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj A ≅ C) →
        ∃ S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ),
          S.X₁ = K₀ ∧ S.Exact ∧ Epi S.g ∧ S.X₂.Acyclic ∧
          (∀ i : ℤ, S.X₂.X i ∈ Pclass) ∧ (∃ b : ℤ, S.X₃.IsStrictlyLE b) ∧
          Nonempty (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj S.X₃ ≅ E⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ∧
          ∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty
            (((S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i)).map
                (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).Splitting)
